Adverbial clauses of time with when / be: A time adverbial clause introduced by when/before/after/as soon as; the future is expressed with the present.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。
when + point in time|before = before, after = after|main clause future, subordinate clause present|as soon as = as soon as|while + continuous action
I will call you when I get home.
column3: 我到家后会给你打电话。

# title: 「我到家后会给你打电话。」的正确英文是?
Adverbial clauses of time with when / be: I will call you when I will get home.|I will call you when I got home.|I will call you when I am getting home.|I will call you when I get home.
column4: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:I will call you when I get home.
